title: Technique
description: A hand-written technique over one GrappleMap transition (data/techniques/*.json): names, steps and notes.

reviewed.description: False until someone who knows the technique has checked the text; the viewer marks it as a draft.

grapplemap_line.description: Line where the transition's block starts in GrappleMap.txt.

from.description: Name of the position it starts from, as a check.

to.description: Name of the position it ends in, as a check.

risk.description: Replaces the generic risk line of the submission kind.
